description: Deterministic per-neuron Poisson GLM with L2 (ridge) regularization. Features (18x18=324) are standardized once using train set mean/std. For each neuron, alpha (regularization strength) is selected by 3-fold cross-validation over a small log-spaced grid using primary objective (Poisson negative log-likelihood). The final model for each neuron is refit on all training data with the chosen alpha. Predictions for test are computed only as a function of image features; identical test images are deduplicated so their predicted rates are identical. Outputs are positive expected spike counts per 300 ms. Implementation uses sklearn.linear_model.PoissonRegressor when available, otherwise falls back to TweedieRegressor(power=1, link='log'). Randomness is fixed for reproducibility. No use of test target labels or trial indices; no external models.
